# Begin Here

If you have just arrived, start with these few messages. They are short, and
each one opens a part of the teaching: who is speaking, what Divine Love is,
how to ask for it, and what to expect when you do.

Read them in order if you can, and read each one through to the end. There is
no hurry.

When you have read these, the [[Essential Teachings Index|Essential Teachings]]
